project_title: የአጎቴ የመጀመሪያ ኮምፒውተር (My Uncle's First Computer)
style_block: Warm expressive stylized comedy illustration, golden morning sunlight in an Addis Ababa living room, clean lines, rich color palette, centered main subject

character_ref.description: Middle-aged Ethiopian man with a neat salt-and-pepper beard, round glasses, cream sweater, dramatic expressive eyebrows

music_cues.caption: Playful light Ethiopian krar and marimba underscore, bouncy gentle rhythm, warm acoustic texture, instrumental only

shots.reason: Establish the setting, Uncle Tadesse, and the comedic premise of his new computer.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of Uncle Tadesse sitting proudly in front of a bulky desktop monitor on a wooden table, hands on hips like a general.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle camera push-in, warm curtain sways slightly in breeze.
shots.narration_am: አጎቴ ታደሰ ኮምፒውተር የገዛ ቀን፣ በሰፈራችን ትልቅ ባለሀብት የሆነ መሰለው።
shots.subtitle_en: The day Uncle Tadesse bought a computer, he acted like the biggest tycoon in the neighborhood.

shots.reason: Show the first physical comedy gag: treating the computer mouse like soap.
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of Uncle Tadesse rubbing a computer mouse back and forth on the desk as if scrubbing clothes with soap, squinting intently.
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle hand movement rubbing the mouse, camera stays steady.
shots.narration_am: ማውሱን እንደ ሳሙና ጠረጴዛው ላይ እያሸ፣ «ለምን አረፋ አያወጣም?» ብሎ ተገረመ።
shots.subtitle_en: Rubbing the mouse on the table like soap, he wondered why it wasn't making suds.

shots.reason: Escalate the joke with loud Amharic command shouts at a login screen.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of Uncle Tadesse leaning close to the glowing monitor with an exaggerated stern face, pointing a finger at the screen.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle zoom on his expressive face as screen light flickers softly.
shots.narration_am: ፓስወርድ ሲጠይቀው፣ «እኔ ታደሰ ነኝ! ክፈት በል አሁኑኑ!» ብሎ በቁጣ አዘዘው።
shots.subtitle_en: When it asked for a password, he commanded it sternly: 'I am Tadesse! Open right now!'

shots.reason: Introduce a visual mishap: accidentally rotating the display upside down.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of Uncle Tadesse tilting his head completely upside down to read a flipped upside-down computer screen, confused expression.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera pan slightly to the left, monitor glow reflects on his glasses.
shots.narration_am: ስክሪኑ ሲገለበጥበት፣ ኪቦርዱን ከመጠየቅ ይልቅ አንገቱን ወደ ኋላ ገልብጦ ማንበብ ጀመረ።
shots.subtitle_en: When the screen flipped upside down, instead of checking the keyboard, he tilted his head back to read.

shots.reason: Bring in a second character (the niece) to create contrast and comedic timing.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of a ten-year-old Ethiopian girl in a school cardigan standing beside Uncle Tadesse with hands on her waist, amused expression.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle push-in toward the girl as she sighs lightly.
shots.narration_am: አስር ዓመት የሆናት የእህቱ ልጅ መጥታ፣ «አጎት፣ ኮምፒውተሩን አላስቆጣኸውም» አለችው።
shots.subtitle_en: His ten-year-old niece walked in and said, 'Uncle, you didn't make the computer angry.'

shots.reason: Show the quick, effortless fix that deflates Uncle Tadesse's dramatic buildup.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of small hands pressing keys on a keyboard while the monitor screen snaps upright cleanly.
shots.motion_prompt: Quick crisp snap of the screen returning upright, camera static.
shots.narration_am: በሦስት ሰከንድ ውስጥ ሁለት ቁልፍ ነካችና ስክሪኑ ወደ ቦታው ተመለሰ።
shots.subtitle_en: In three seconds she pressed two keys, and the screen snapped right back.

shots.reason: Deliver the punchline where Uncle Tadesse claims credit for the fix.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of Uncle Tadesse sitting back with a smug grin and crossed arms as if he planned the whole thing.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle pull-back, warm light settles over the room.
shots.narration_am: አጎቴም ፈገግ ብሎ፣ «እኔም ላደርገው ነበር፣ ልሞክራት ብዬ ነው የገለበጥኩት» አለ።
shots.subtitle_en: Uncle grinned and said, 'I was about to do that—I only flipped it to test it.'

shots.reason: Close on a warm family takeaway and comedic tag.
shots.image_prompt: Warm wide shot of Uncle Tadesse and his niece laughing together by the sunny window with the computer humming quietly.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle Ken Burns zoom out, dust motes float in sunlight.
shots.narration_am: ቴክኖሎጂ ቢቀየርም፣ የአጎቴ ታደሰ በራስ መተማመን ግን ፈጽሞ አይቀየርም።
shots.subtitle_en: Technology may change, but Uncle Tadesse's self-confidence never changes.
